summary: June nonfarm payrolls came in at just 57,000, well below expectations, while the unemployment rate ticked down to 4.2%. That soft jobs report has pulled back market expectations for a Fed rate hike, with the probability of a July FOMC hike dropping to 20% from 30% the prior week. Meanwhile, Trump announced a 50% tariff on copper today, rattling commodities and adding fresh trade uncertainty across asset classes.
tweet: A 57K jobs miss cut Fed hike odds and lifted stocks, but a surprise 50% copper tariff landed today — trade risk is back on the table.
